usage: policy for webhooks directing to URLs with unknown VT reputation
name: Webhook URL should be shared across repos
description: A malicious actor may attempt to access the code permanently by implementing a webhook. In addition, unauthorized webhooks may leak data like code and secrets.
detailedDescription: After successfully compromising a user's account, a malicious actor may attempt to access the code permanently by implementing a webhook. Separately, unauthorized webhooks may leak data like code and secrets. For these reasons, an inventory of uncommonly used webhooks is suitable for an organization.

args.name: MaxRepoPercent
args.label: Max Repo Percent
args.tooltip: An issue will only be generated if the webhook URL is present in less than the selected percentage of repositories.

args.label: Max Repo Count
args.name: MaxRepoCount
args.tooltip: An issue will only be generated if the webhook URL is present in less than the selected count of repositories.
